consequence.statement: The cleanup command now also removes the ISTIO_OUTPUT iptables chain; previously the chain remained after running it.

original.statement: The `pilot-agent istio-clean-iptables` command now removes the `ISTIO_OUTPUT` iptables chain, which it previously left behind.

decision.reason: [ev-dd94d38ea856] says only that `pilot-agent istio-clean-iptables` now removes the `ISTIO_OUTPUT` iptables chain, which it used to leave behind. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or needs migrating, so a mandatory-work kind would over-claim. The cleanup command still works but now leaves different iptables state, so behavior-change at low severity (review) fits what the evidence says.
